readings.title: Attention-based Deep Multiple Instance Learning
source_facts: p2: binary bag label follows max of latent instance labels; instances assumed unordered and without dependencies.
p3 Eq7-8: trainable softmax attention pooling over learned embeddings, general real-valued embeddings and learned bag classifier.
p4 Eq9: gated attention variant; high attention as key-instance proxy is framed as an ideal/interpretation, not proof that attention equals instance-label probability.
limits: Results pp5 onward, appendix, supplement and code not audited; no reproduction.
Binary MIL label semantics and independent instances are not established for contextual entity-marked Re-TACRED word embeddings.
General f/g function statements do not establish expressivity or risk for restricted three-qubit RMEA.

readings.title: Deep Sets
read_locators: pp1-3 introduction, theorem statements and conditional architecture
source_facts: p2 Theorem2: exact invariant-set decomposition stated for a countable universe; uncountable case discussed with fixed set size, with remaining generality a conjecture.
p3: sum of feature embeddings followed by rho, optionally condition phi on additional metadata z.
p2 Lemma3 concerns a particular permutation-equivariant neural layer; not a general native40-class performance theorem.
limits: pp4-11 empirical sections/references and supplemental AppendixA proofs not audited; no code reproduction.
Universality of suitable unrestricted phi/rho does not certify finite-width, restricted circuit, ratio pooling or generalization.
Pooling-level reordering of contextual embeddings is not raw-text or entity-renaming invariance.
